metadataRaw.title: How to Heal and Repair Your Knee WITHOUT SURGERY
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates exercises designed to help heal and repair knee injuries and damage—without surgery.

These moves focus on improving blood flow and circulation to the knee, speeding up the healing of soft tissues (including cartilage), while also strengthening the key muscles and tendons that support knee stability.

Each exercise targets the knee differently. For best results, try them all and use the ones that work best for you.

Watch now and take a step toward avoiding knee surgery!

0:00 Intro
1:27 Circulation Exercise 1
